entry_activation_level.label: upper-band retest trigger
entry_activation_level.reason: The strategic short is still alive, but current price is already pressing the lower half of local 15m value. A bounce back into the top of the accepted failure band and underside of 15m value offers better location than chasing near 2130 support.

entry_zone.label: sell rejection pocket
entry_zone.reason: This zone aligns the failure-band top, 15m VAH, 15m RVWAP +1/+2, and the densest recent sell-stack footprint overhead, making it the highest-quality short re-entry area.

entry_invalidation_level.label: pullback rejection failure
entry_invalidation_level.reason: Acceptance above RVWAP +2 and the upper sell-stack cluster would mean the chosen pullback-rejection structure failed and that squeeze risk is increasing toward the broader 2140+ reclaim shelf.
